reason: My team already tracks open POs and shortages in our own Excel tracker, and I trust that more than anything else in the stack. A stranger who wants our PO, job and material data, cleaned up by us first, to tell me something my planners should already know is a hard sell, and I would need IT and legal to sign off before any ERP export leaves the building.
objection: Our BOM and job data is messy; any analysis will be wrong, and the first report will be full of false alarms that waste my planners' time.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a peer at a similar Epicor shop showing that the audit caught a supplier date change their team had missed, with the same kind of messy data.
